name: Triumph Street Triple 765
engine: 765 cc liquid-cooled inline triple, fuel injected
intro: Triumph's naked triple. Mostly routine service. Check recalls and crash damage.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2018-2020 Street Triple RS bikes were in a Triumph recall (SRAN579) for the Brembo front brake.
A-002.reason: Brake recalls are free to fix and matter.

E: Check the bar ends, footpegs, levers and radiator for crash damage.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.
